topic.title: Integrating Web Author in Your Workflow

keywords.indexterm: Integrating Web Author in your workflow

body.p: One of the advantages of is that it allows contributors (such as reviewers or support engineers) to streamline the documentation workflow by proposing changes or adding comments directly in the XML source. The documentation team can then incorporate those changes and suggestions without extra steps.
You can launch at any point in your content workflow by embedding a link in a web page, email message, or published output. When users select the link, opens the specified file for editing.

You can also streamline and control your workflow by embedding a custom action in the Web Author interface. For example, you can configure an action to check a file in or out, making file management easier for users.
